240-5231-5470-8296.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2174-2645-3430-4717.easyPrerequisites: Juniper Order Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2174-2645-3430-4717.description:
Activate City of Traitors by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping City of Traitors
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

3301-5107-5261.easyPrerequisites:
Rally of Wings is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
3301-5107-5261.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
3301-5107-5261.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Rally of Wings without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Rally of Wings, untapping all creatures you control and giving creatures you control that have flying +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2.

147-2034-8129.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2034-8129.notablePrerequisites: There are at least seven cards in your graveyard.
147-2034-8129.description:
Cast Stitch Together by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Stitch Together.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Stitch Together
Resolve the Stitch Together copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

851-1308-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Adrix and Nev and Anointed Procession.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
851-1308-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

2173-4050-5258-5758.manaNeeded: {G} if Sunshower Druid is in your hand
2173-4050-5258-5758.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2 if Sunshower Druid is on top of your library.
2173-4050-5258-5758.description:
Cast Sunshower Druid either from your hand by paying {G} or from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Sunshower Druid enters, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature and causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Sunshower Druid, adding {B}.
Activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Sunshower Druid from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

215-1355-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
215-1355-6791.description:
Activate Sanctum Weaver by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Sanctum Weaver from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Sanctum Weaver by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

907-1558-2638-4231-4772.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1558-2638-4231-4772.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Doubling Season.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

6797-6972-7231.notablePrerequisites: There are at least two creature cards in all graveyards.
6797-6972-7231.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Drakestown Forgotten.
When Drakestown Forgotten dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

2781-5147-6767.description:
Cast Felidar Guardian by paying its mana cost.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Rescue Skiff
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Felidar Guardian.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian ability, blinking Rescue Skiff
When Rescue Skiff enters, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

997-5170-6132-6634.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

618-5231-6966.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of All-Fates Stalker.
When the All-Fates Stalker token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the All-Fates Stalker token.
When the All-Fates Stalker token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1894-4699-5220-6900.description:
Activate Bile Urchin by sacrificing it.
When Bile Urchin dies, Mortuary and Overgrowth Elemental trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Bile Urchin from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Overgrowth Elemental trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Bile Urchin ability.
Cast Bile Urchin from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

198-1978-3007.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
198-1978-3007.description:
Animate Empowered Autogenerator using Toymaker.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {1} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat from step 2.
198-1978-3007.notes: The combo assumes Empowered Autogenerator has no charge counters on it when you start. If it has charge counters, the mana cost is reduced by {1}.

940-4831-5166.description:
Activate Cacophodon by tapping it, dealing damage to any target.
Guilty Conscience triggers, dealing damage to Cacophodon.
Cacophodon triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

252-2438-4871.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token that enters the battlefield as a 7/7 Dinosaur due to Displaced Dinosaurs.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

3362-6472.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast Deceptive Frostkite
3362-6472.description:
Cast Deceptive Frostkite by paying its mana cost, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Bladewing.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Deceptive Frostkite's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning Bladewing from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Put Bladewing into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Bladewing's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.

678-4506-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-4506-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

394-856-997-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

955-1308-1563-2457.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

261-3490-5231-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
261-3490-5231-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Suture Priest indestructible.
261-3490-5231-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

11-4377-5257.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}.
Riku's first ability triggers - choose not to pay.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Walk the Aeons.
Riku's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {U}{R} to copy Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Walk the Aeons, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal created in step 5, copying Walk the Aeons and returning the original Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
11-4377-5257.notes: You may pay an additional {U}{R} to copy the extra turn spell, and only need to do this loop during your second extra turn.

2018-4053-5754.manaNeeded: {1}{R}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
2018-4053-5754.description:
Cast Phlage either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Resolve the second trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the first trigger, causing you to sacrifice Phlage.
When Phlage dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield without a flying counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat from step 2.

1218-4909-5064.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least five untapped Goblins.
You have less than nine poison counters.
1218-4909-5064.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, giving Skirk Fire Marshal +1/+0 and infect until end of turn.
Activate Skirk Fire Marshal by tapping five Goblins you control, putting ten -1/-1 counters on each creature and giving each opponent ten poison counters, and you one poison counter.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten poison counters.

2218-3558-4763-5147.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters the battlefield, Ronin Warclub triggers, attaching Ronin Warclub to Crookshank Kobolds.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1167-1860-4502.description:
Activate Mindslaver by paying {4}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to gain control of target player during their next turn.
During the opponent's turn, activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Game of Chaos by paying {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve Game of Chaos, choosing to continue flipping a coin until the opponent loses the flip and the amount of life wagered is greater than or equal to the opponent's life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

1126-2596-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six nontoken creatures.
1126-2596-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing all creatures you control, adding at least {4}{B}{B}.
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}, causing each player to exile all creature cards from their graveyard, sacrifice all creatures they control, then return all cards exiled this way to the battlefield.
Activate Xiahou Dun by sacrificing it, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

678-3003-4326.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five artifacts.
678-3003-4326.description:
Cast Multiform Wonder by paying {0}.
Multiform Wonder enters the battlefield, causing you to gain {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Multiform Wonder's third ability twice by paying {E}{E}, giving Multiform Wonder +4/-4 until end of turn.
Multiform Wonder dies as a state-based action due to having less than zero toughness.
Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Multiform Wonder from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
